Action.description:
Any other action. Preserved, but validation reports it: Pipecat only runs
actions with a registered handler, and a JSON document can't carry one.
Action.title: Action

AgentConfig.description: A complete agent: identity + the conversation graph.

persona.description: Global role message, applied to every node.

first_message.description: Said when the call starts, without an LLM call; the initial node then waits for the caller.

AgentConfig.title: AgentConfig

patient.description: Facts the caller stated; null for one fact clears it.

slot_id.description: A slot id from get_availability that the caller picked.

service_text.description: The service the caller chose, in their words; omit service_id when using this.

provider_text.description: The provider the caller chose; omit provider_id when using this.

location_text.description: The location the caller chose; omit location_id when using this.

draft_revision.description: The draft revision the caller confirmed.

confirmed.description: True only after the caller said yes to the read-back.

BookingDraft.description: The caller's current choices. Nothing here is booked.
BookingDraft.title: BookingDraft

Cleared.description: An earlier choice an update removed because it no longer fits.
Cleared.title: Cleared

Edge.description: A transition out of a node, exposed to the LLM as a callable tool.

function.description: Tool name the LLM calls to take this edge.

description.description: When the model should call it.

target.description: Name of the node to transition to.

properties.description: Values to collect on this edge, as JSON-schema properties.

guard.description: A named check that must pass before the edge is taken (see the registry).

auto_after.description: Node tools after which the edge is taken without an LLM call, when the call changed the state and the guard passes.

Edge.title: Edge

EndConversationAction.description: End the call, optionally saying `text` first (Pipecat's built-in `end_conversation`).
EndConversationAction.title: EndConversationAction

Facts.description: The caller's facts; null means not known yet.
Facts.title: Facts

query.description: The place the caller said, e.g. 'downtown'.

name.description: The name the caller said, e.g. 'Dr. Chen'.

Issue.description: One problem with an agent document.
Issue.title: Issue

Message.description: An LLM message, passed to Pipecat verbatim (any additional fields included).
Message.title: Message

Node.description: A single conversational state. Fields mirror Pipecat Flows' NodeConfig.

name.description: Unique within the agent; edges target nodes by name.

tools.description: Registry tools the node exposes besides its edges.

enter_tools.description: Registry tools run without arguments when the node is entered; their results are added to the result of the transition into it.

end.description: Terminal: the call ends after this node.

Node.title: Node

is_new_patient.description: True if the caller has never been seen at our clinics.

has_referral.description: Whether a referral is on file for the service.

PatientFacts.description: What the caller has told us about themselves. None means not known yet.
PatientFacts.title: PatientFacts

Position.description: A node's canvas position. The compiler ignores it.
Position.title: Position

PropertySchema.description:
A JSON-schema property for a value an edge collects.

Only the keywords the builder's forms edit are declared; any other keyword
(`items`, `minimum`, ...) is preserved and passed to the LLM unchanged.
PropertySchema.title: PropertySchema

query.description: What the caller asked for, in their words (e.g. 'knee MRI').

specialty.description: Only services with this specialty label.

approx_tokens.description: Estimated size of `result` (about 4 characters a token), not a tokenizer count.

patient.description: Facts the caller stated; null for one fact clears it.

slot_id.description: A slot id from get_availability that the caller picked.
